apps.name: Doom (1993)
apps.subtitle: id Software · Shareware Episode 1
apps.description: Classic 1993 Doom running natively on the Velliangiri framebuffer at 1280x720. Use directional keys to move, Select to fire, and hold Menu for 2 seconds to return to Giri.

apps.name: Temple Chess
apps.subtitle: Grandmaster Engine · 6-Button Remote
apps.description: Temple Chess is a clean 10-foot chess board designed for the 6-button remote. Navigate squares with directional keys and press Select to pick up or place pieces.

apps.name: Western Ghats FM
apps.subtitle: Ambient & Classical Streams
apps.description: Western Ghats FM streams Carnatic instrumental sessions, monsoon rain recordings, and All India Radio bulletins with low-power background audio playback.

apps.name: Monsoon Radar
apps.subtitle: Coimbatore & Nilgiri Telemetry
apps.description: Live barometric, wind shear, and rainfall contour viewer for the Palghat Gap, Nilgiri biosphere, and Velliangiri foothills.
